text_block_list.text:
Summer camp starts today. The press
floods the
camp, rattling off all kinds of
questions
comparing Нарита Брайан to
Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф is unfazed, but Narita
Brian's
competitive nature kicks in and
she seeks to draw
Симболи Рудольф into a
match.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The air between them is slowly but
surely heating
up. And so, summer camp
begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
